correctness.rationale: For ordered projected tetrahedron heights h1<...<h4, precisely the offset slab (h2,h3) cuts four cross-partition edges. In any of 48 congruent signed-order normal sectors, Q=(X-Y)/(X+Y) for X>=Y>=Z absolute coordinates. Put t=Y/X, s=Z/X; the spherical area density is (1+t²+s²)^(-3/2) dt ds, giving f_T(t)=12t/[pi(1+t²)sqrt(1+2t²)]. Integration yields the stated survival function for every 0<=q<=1; elementary integration gives Haar-mean 0.298746285571..., distinct from Cauchy-Steiner width-biased plane mean 0.288535543072.... Domain: nondegenerate regular tetrahedron and Haar normal, uniform intersecting offsets, generic normals; endpoints have no atom. Independently computed 100000 random projected normals: empirical mean .299585 and survival at q=.45 .24179 versus analytic .240859; this checks only finite samples, not the integral proof.
